facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: The princess cried. The well was deep. She could not reach it. She dropped her golden ball.
facts.Page story text 2 (draft, teacher check: The princess sat by the well and cried bitterly. She dropped her golden ball into the deep dark well. The well was too deep for her to reach the bottom. The golden ball was a special gift from her father. She did not know what to do without her treasure. Her tears fell into the water like little rain drops.
facts.Word cards: dropped = 떨어뜨렸다 / golden = 황금색의 / well = 우물 / deep = 깊은
